name: Sidequery AI
title: sidequery.dev
shortDescription: Sidequery is a browser-based analytics tool designed for users who need to analyze JSON and CSV data locally. It's currently in alpha, promising more features soon. Ideal for data analysts and developers, Sidequery ensures data privacy by processing data on your device without uploading it to external servers. Example use case: Analyzing sales data directly from your local files without data privacy concerns.
cons: Still in alpha, might be unstable
Requires a large screen for optimal use
